== Biography ==
Daniel was born about 1829 at Kildare, County Kildare, Ireland. He was the son of Charles Glasgow and Julia Burns.

He emigrated to Australia with his family. They arrived in Australia on 5 October 1840, aboard the vessel 'Elphinstone'. At that time the age of family members were : Charles 40, Julia 38, Ian? 17, Thomas 15, Daniel 11, Anne 13, James 5.

He married Bridget Brunton about 1856 in Victoria, Australia.
They had the following children together (possibly more);
#Charles 1858-1920(NZ)
#Catherine 1864-1876
#Julia (Gilliland) 1867-1938
#Thomas Brunton 1869-1965
#Esther Jane (Yates) 1871-1958
#Daniel James 1874-1876 (18mths)
#Peter John 1876-1937
#James Francis 1877-1949

His occupation was as a farmer.

He passed away on 3 July 1897 at Rutherglen, Victoria, Australia.
<ref>VIC Death Reg. number : 10436/1897</ref>

He was buried at Carlyle Cemetery, Rutherglen, Indigo Shire, Victoria, Australia.
<ref>Find-a-grave : https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/185874229/daniel-glasgow</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Elphinstone family originals — 31 October 2026 ===
The inspected Elphinstone family papers list Charles Glasgow, gardener, aged 40, native of County Kildare and Roman Catholic, and Julie Glasgow, a married woman from the same native place as her husband. The children are listed in source order as Jno (John), 18; Thomas, 15; Daniel, 11; James, 5; and Anne, 13.<ref name="Elphinstone1840Family">[https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSKD-J9W8-Y Elphinstone immigrant papers, original image 385, Charles Glasgow]; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSKD-J9W8-B original image 386, Julie and children]. Original scan inspected 31 October 2026 by the research assistant.</ref> The official New South Wales guide dates the ship’s arrival to 5 October 1840.<ref>[https://mhnsw.au/guides/assisted-immigrants-digital-shipping-lists/ Museums of History NSW, Assisted immigrants digital shipping lists, Elphinstone arrival].</ref>

Charles’s parent column names “Thos”, labourer, and his mother “Anne Du[?]e”; the latter is not his wife’s maiden name. Charles swore to baptism in November 1800, not an exact birthday. Julie’s parent column names “Thos”, farmer, and Jane Flanagan. Her stated age 38 in December 1840 conflicts with her sworn birth in December 1801; retain this discrepancy and an approximate year rather than an exact date. Burns remains an unverified maiden surname from the current biography/memorial tradition, not a newly verified reading of this entry.

Certification-column dates are not birthdays. Faint birth annotations supply no independently verified basis for changing Daniel’s exact birth field. No exact death date, Scottish ancestry bridge or identity merge follows. James Glasgow-3265 of Tenterfield is a very compatible adult candidate for the five-year-old James and must remain on identity HOLD, not be rejected to create another person. The other passenger children likewise retain their qualified adult-identity comparisons.


The complete passenger-to-adult identification supports new father Charles at 95% and mother Julie at 93% subjective confidence; the shared identity premise is not two independent proofs. The held Victorian death-index extract 10436/1897 in the existing biography names father Chas and mother unknown; the official death record was not newly inspected. The initial biography’s Julie/Julia Burns statement is retained as an unverified maiden-name tradition, not confirmed by the immigrant papers. No exact birth field is changed.
